name: LatencyLens
heading: Debug the wait, then measure again.
description: Measure p50/p95 against a deployed synthetic OpenAI-compatible response endpoint. Compare uncached requests with a reusable deterministic fast path.
label: Synthetic prompt
sample: Synthetic integration notes: A timeout occurs when a response exceeds the configured deadline. A slow response completes within the deadline but later than expected. Summarize that distinction in two short sentences.
notice: Actual timed HTTP requests to a synthetic endpoint. No real inference, provider credentials, or model API charges. Fast/slow are deliberately implemented fixture paths, not claims about Novita performance.
